before: A table row that held only vertical merge heads and continuations took one default text line, or no height when its marks were hidden, whatever its smaller minimum row height.
after: That row takes the height of its first cell's end-of-cell paragraph, or its minimum row height when that is taller. Beside a btLr cell, a minimum row height alone sizes it.
reason: The change is in table row layout only. Shared state, operations, and synchronization are unchanged.
